data.standardized_narrative: Unable to locate a clear gross prior-year reserve movement figure in the scanned images. The report emphasises material natural catastrophe exposure and notes lower catastrophe activity in 2019 versus 2018 (citing Hurricanes Florence and Michael and, to a lesser extent, Harvey and Irma). No authoritative gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' figure was extractable with confidence from the provided images, so the prior year development (release/strengthening) amount is not reported.
raw_causal_phrases: The Syndicate has material natural catastrophe exposure.

Result improvements in part reflect lower catastrophe activity in 2019 compared to 2018 (Hurricanes Florence and Michael which occurred in the 2018 calendar year) and to a lesser extent Hurricanes Harvey and Irma which occurred in the 2017 calendar year.
data.data_quality_notes: Document provided as scanned images with rotated pages and limited legibility. Key required figures (gross claims outstanding at 1 Jan 2019 from the Balance Sheet and the gross movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding) could not be reliably read/extracted from the images. The gross written premium total was readable in the Managing Agent's report table (256,232 in thousands). Named catastrophe events were referenced in text and have been captured. Where gross figures were not explicitly found, fields are null. If higher-fidelity (searchable) PDF or clearer images are provided, I can extract the precise gross opening reserves and the gross prior-year development amount and populate the claims triangle.
